name: Kamishiro Ikki
source:
The head of the Kamishiro household and Saya's husband.
Ikki is currently undergoing treatment for a chronic illness that has limited the use of his legs. Largely bedridden due to his condition, he has entrusted Saya with overseeing the family business for the time being.
